lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, including a distinct grouping of three primary spots forming an obtuse triangle superior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity define the spatial distribution of spots, which are primarily located in the inter-band zones.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature running parallel to the longitudinal axis above the pectoral fin, marked by a sharp vertical transition from high luminance (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to and swimming near the ventral-lateral flank.
